meta.name: The Pet Cemetery Murders: A Ghost Story
meta.description: The re-opening of a mysterious 1985 cold case murder in Louisiana unearths a haunting history of bloodshed and long-buried trauma.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: A decades-old Louisiana cold case involving the gruesome death of Dorothy Lou Thompson, the owner of a pet cemetery, gains traction after a startling account launches investigators down various haunting leads.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Detectives make strides in Dorothy's case, and an unlikely witness comes forward with a vexing admission. As police dig further into Dorothy's fraught past, details emerge about her struggles with addiction and the mysterious deaths of her past husbands.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Although Dorothy's murder gets solved, what was unearthed in her case is a trail of murders, mobsters, and a horrific history that still haunts this community.
